Attacking

Choose a visible enemy to attack.

Attack-move engages enemies along the route. Forced commands can target otherwise friendly units.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Combat with an enemy

Occasionally, despite your efforts to avoid combat, you will encounter enemies your character must fight. Enemies do not appear on the screen until your character can see them.

To attack an enemy place the cursor on him and, when the cursor changes into a sword, click. Your character will start fighting this enemy and will continue until the enemy dies. If the enemy is moving quickly it can be difficult to place the cursor on him, so you should use "pause" mode (<SPACE> bar).

Move and attack

You can issue your character the "Go and prepare to attack" command. This puts him in a fighting mode and he'll attack all enemies he sees.

To issue this command, press and hold the <CTRL> key then click on a destination point. He will move towards this location, fighting any enemies he sees on the way.

Note: in this mode your character will attack all enemies he sees near his location. If you try to send him to a location too far off, he'll defend himself if attacked on the way. After that, however, he will stop and wait for further instruction.
